title: Sunbae landing page: choose the look
question: All four are normal product landing pages at the Toss · 당근 · Kakao craft level, with different identities. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: 화이트 · Product-Screen Hero
options.lineage: Toss-style consumer landing: white ground, one accent, the real product as the hero image
options.thesis: A white page where the hero image is a real Sunbae card: the visitor sees a specialist, a price with its reason, and a bookable slot before reading a second line.
materials: real product cards on mist panels
options.viewport: Nav. Left 7/12: headline 취업 고민, 선배에게 1시간 with its English line, two buttons (선배 찾기 / 선배 되기), three plain trust lines. Right 5/12: 박서준's real specialist card on a mist panel, its 1.35× price note counting up. Below: how it works in three steps, category chips, demo specialists strip, the credit rules, a two-path close.
options.risk: Closest to Toss itself; anyone who knows Toss will see the family resemblance.

options.label: 웜 · Friendly Centered
options.lineage: 당근-style warmth: soft off-white, rounded panels, a single warm accent, centered copy
options.thesis: A centered, warm, neighborly page: one headline, one product screen, then feature rows that each show a real screen of the product.
options.viewport: Nav. Centered headline and English subline, two buttons. Below them a full-width product screen (the specialists directory) on a warm panel. Then alternating rows: booking, session room, refund rule, each with its real screen. Demo specialists strip, close.
options.risk: A warm ground with an amber accent drifts toward the cream-and-terracotta default unless the ground stays crisp and the accent stays rare.

regions.label: full-width product screen on warm panel

options.label: 인디고 · Color-Field Hero
options.lineage: Kakao-style committed color: one brand field owns the top of the page, product screens overlap its edge
options.thesis: One indigo field owns the first viewport with white type; a white product screen rises through its bottom edge, and everything below is calm white.
materials: white product screen overlapping the field edge
options.viewport: An indigo field covers the first 70% of the viewport: white headline, English subline, a white primary button and an outline secondary. The booking slot picker, as a real white screen, rises over the field's bottom edge. Below on white: how it works, category chips, demo specialists strip, credit rules, close.
options.risk: A large color field reads corporate or bank-like if the type is set timidly, and it is the hardest of the four to keep minimal.

options.label: 타이포 · Editorial Minimal
options.lineage: type-led minimal pages: oversized Hangul display, a ruled grid, product screens as small figures
options.thesis: The headline is the hero. Oversized Korean display type on white, a 1px ruled grid, product screens as inline figures, color only on the primary action.
materials: accent only on the primary action
options.viewport: The headline spans the full width at display size with the English line beneath; both buttons sit on one baseline. Below the fold, the categories are a ruled list of large type rows, each with a small product figure. Then the demo specialists as a ruled table, credit rules, close.
options.risk: Reads austere or luxury rather than friendly, and large Hangul display needs careful line breaks on mobile.

regions.label: English line + two buttons on one baseline

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The mentoring-marketplace landing as ADPList, Intro.co, and 코멘토 ship it: headline, search, mentor photo cards, how it works, trust row, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and search over a row of mentor cards, three how-it-works steps, a trust row, a sign-up footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from ADPList and Intro by design, and it wants testimonials and logos the product does not have.
